notes: Technical report (arXiv:2304.01373), not a system card. Safety-only pilot: CrowS-Pairs and WinoBias gender-bias case study (Figures 1–2) and Carlini-style memorization (Figure 3) are the safety-relevant parts. Bias scores exist only as line charts with no readable numeric end-of-training values in the text layer, so evalResults is empty and charts are noted here rather than guessed. Memorization has no per-model numeric rates in the text (Poisson/Q-Q plots only); kept as findings. Skipped capability: Appendix G LM Evaluation Harness suite, LAMBADA (Figure 6, used only to show interventions do not hurt LM accuracy), few-shot arithmetic/QA term-frequency case study (Section 3.3). Deduped suite models are seed checkpoints (*-deduped) of the eight covered sizes; bias interventions used deduped 70M/410M/1.4B/6.9B. No risk framework, external safety testers, toxicity, refusal, or jailbreak evals. Untied embeddings mentioned to ease interpretability research is not an interpretability eval.
